required_upstream_applicability.reason: U7 is a static Markdown/CSV packaging Unit with no runtime performance, serving, or latency contract.
U7 creates no API, database, service instance, or concurrent learner state, so scaling requirements do not apply.
U7 has no stateful execution path or availability SLO; file validation failures are handled as review/blocking states.
U7 performs no telemetry, logging, alerting, or tracing; static check results are handed off to U8 as evidence.
